heuristics: H1: the mixed add/square class walk on N = (r-1)/12 classes with r_a = 1024 and S = 458 square slots behaves as a random map with collision rate V = 0.799413681, the sum of squared branch probabilities of the actual partition (566 reachable additive adders).

H2: 2-cycles are checked every step and cycles of length 3 to 64 against a per-walk anchor; detections escape by squaring the least-key state. The 2-cycle branch is checked by exact replica equality; the 3-to-64 branch is mirrored and fired once in production.
H3: c2 = 0.1450 and kappa = 0.4902 are Callgrind measurements at S = 458 at zero distinguished-point density, from interval counts on two seeds (agreeing to 0.01%).

H5: undetected cycles of length above 64 are formal cancellations (rate (ell-1)!! ((1-s)/(12 r_a))^(ell/2)) or non-formal closures (probability 1/r per candidate). The formal part is checked against the measured 2-cycle rate (ratio 1.002).
H6: for every square count q <= 2^66, 2^q is not a 12th root of unity modulo r (checked for 2^(12k) != 1, k <= 200000).
limitations: H1 is extrapolated from toy groups with N up to 2^17 and r_a = 32; production N is about 2^251 and r_a = 1024.
The trail-cap restart is specified and charged but cannot be reached by measurement runs; no production-size execution of the walk to a collision.
The replica checks use distinguished-point density 1/16, not 2^-60.
Memory of about 2^73 bytes is not realisable; memory is reported, not scored.
